cursor_resolver.result_summary:
The review findings are valid, and the correction is already on the builder pull request. Reviewed commit `1c6b9e93` proved expected effects with the wrong predicates: `ACCOUNT_RECLASS` credited `fromAccountId` and debited `toAccountId`, which is the reverse of the locked first-run accrual (debit the expense, credit the accrued liability). resolver_result.root_cause: Reviewed SHA 1c6b9e93 verified expected effects against predicates that contradict locked JE custody. ACCOUNT_RECLASS required a credit on fromAccountId and a debit on toAccountId, while the first-run accrual debits the expense account (fromAccountId) and credits the accrued-liability account (toAccountId). Canonical extraction treated QBO normalizedTransactions and trial-balance netAmount as the provider journal and the GL ending, and copied tie-out totals_status into the recon outcome, so a real SUCCESS sync never proved the journal and a totals-status word could pass without recon_outcome or unidentified_residual_cents.
evidence: At 1c6b9e93, lib/journal-entry-governance/post-write-verification-effects.ts ACCOUNT_RECLASS matched creditCents on fromAccountId and debitCents on toAccountId.

lib/journal-entry-governance/je3d-first-run-evidence-coherence.ts buildFirstRunEvidenceCoherentExpectedEffects sets fromAccountId to the expense account and toAccountId to the accrued-liability account.
lib/journal-entry-governance/je3d-first-run-execution-authority.ts requires the sequence-sorted lines to debit the approved expense account and credit the approved accrued-liability account.

lib/integrations/quickbooks/provider.ts stores normalizedTransactions through normalizeQuickBooksReportEntities with ids quickbooks:${sourceReport}:${index}:${label}. normalizeQuickBooksTrialBalance copies that synthetic id into accountId and the report amount into netAmount. Those entities do not carry journal lines.

The JE-4 proof contracts on this branch were already correct. I fixed the two remaining review blockers on the same pull request.

- An open `IN_PROGRESS` row is now single-flighted. A second caller returns that row and does not start another capture or Continuous Close observe unless it wins a compare-and-set claim. Only a stale claim can be reclaimed after a crash.
- If saving the verification row fails, the result returns the last persisted row. It no longer reports an unsaved `EFFECTS_VERIFI

In-progress re-entry does not reuse the open row and can run a second FRESH_CAPTURE and Continuous Close OBSERVE for the same execution and policy.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: JE-4 orchestration module exists and is execution-bound to VERIFIED custody (or a fixture path that simulates VERIFIED without enabling gates).
acceptance_criteria.notes: runPostWriteVerification loads execution, proposal, and ledger receipt and rejects non-VERIFIED custody. Company, connection, and sync identity come from that custody. Caller company and sync keys are rejected before refresh. The production entry stays behind a hardcoded-off JE-4 gate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Post-write path performs or clearly stages provider/canonical refresh, affected recon/URM, Tie-Out where required, CC OBSERVE, expected-effect verification, readiness refresh, and evidence persistence.
acceptance_criteria.notes: The orchestrator calls FRESH_CAPTURE without a caller sync id, requires a new SUCCESS sync at-or-after VERIFIED, checks snapshot-backed AR/AP/inventory baselines, replays OBSERVE on that sync, composes readiness, verifies effects, and persists journal_entry_post_write_verifications. Real QBO report entities without an explicit journal-line collection conclude EFFECTS_INCOMPLETE rather than VERIFIED.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Expected-effect verification fails closed on mismatch, stale, partial, or lag-without-evidence.
acceptance_criteria.notes: Mismatch, stale sync, partial lines, absent journal representation, and pending visibility are distinct non-success conclusions. EFFECTS_VERIFIED requires a new sync, a new CC run, and readiness. Trial-balance comparison balances are not used as GL proof.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Idempotent re-entry does not duplicate material CC/recon corruption.
acceptance_criteria.notes: A finished row is reused and that sequential path is tested. An IN_PROGRESS row is not reused. A concurrent caller or retry adopts it and runs FRESH_CAPTURE and/or OBSERVE again, which can mint another sync and another Continuous Close run for the same execution and policy.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Partial failures produce explicit non-success statuses.
acceptance_criteria.notes: Refresh, canonical, tie-out, observe, and effect failures persist REFRESH_FAILED, CANONICAL_INCOMPLETE, TIE_OUT_FAILED, OBSERVE_FAILED, EFFECTS_MISMATCH, EFFECTS_INCOMPLETE, or PENDING_PROVIDER_VISIBILITY. The verified-alignment check forbids a VERIFIED conclusion unless status is EFFECTS_VERIFIED.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unit/integration tests cover happy path (fixture), effect mismatch, idempotent replay, and at least one partial-failure path.
acceptance_criteria.notes: post-write-verification.test.ts covers those cases with injected deps, including reclass direction, recon_outcome versus totals_status, and GL detail versus trial balance. Independent run on the reviewed SHA: 27 passed. The missing case is concurrent in-progress re-entry.

findings.requirement: Idempotent re-entry must reuse the prior JE-4 row and must not duplicate material Continuous Close or reconciliation effects under polling, retries, or overlapping requests.
findings.location: selectPostWriteReuseRow (lines 166-176); IN_PROGRESS adoption (lines 532-537 and 576-592); observation continues at line 684
findings.explanation: selectPostWriteReuseRow ignores IN_PROGRESS rows, so a second call does not reuse the open run. It adopts that row and continues the pipeline. Before a sync checkpoint this starts another FRESH_CAPTURE. After the checkpoint it skips capture and still calls Continuous Close OBSERVE again. Both paths can persist an extra accounting sync and an extra close run for one execution and policy. Sequential reuse after a terminal row is implemented and tested; overlapping in-progress re-entry is not.
findings.remediation: Single-flight the open row. If an IN_PROGRESS row already exists, return it without starting another FRESH_CAPTURE or OBSERVE unless this worker holds a compare-and-set claim. Crash resume should reclaim only a stale claim. Add a test where a second call arrives while the first row is still IN_PROGRESS and assert observation and observe each run once.

findings.requirement: Do not report effect VERIFIED when the verification row was not persisted.
findings.explanation: If the repository update throws, failureResult returns ok false with code je4_run_update_failed, but the attached run is the unsaved in-memory row. When that attempted status is EFFECTS_VERIFIED, run.status still says verified even though the database write failed.
findings.remediation: On update failure, return the last persisted row or run null. Do not return an unpersisted EFFECTS_VERIFIED snapshot.
